reading: This is a hero section sketch: a top navigation bar, a small eyebrow label, a giant three-line headline with one hollow word, two pill buttons, a 3D stack of three overlapping cards to the right, and a row of three flat dashes below acting as a slide indicator. Typed notes give exact colors, type, and styling for each piece, including a page-wide indigo-to-black gradient background with white Helvetica text.
